answer: Sybils lose when identity has a price in time. Each agent posts a refundable bond that unlocks only after older peers, funded from unrelated sources, grade genuine work over several epochs. Fresh keys that wander in together from one wallet, matching timing and phrasing, are clustered the way a raven flags the same scavenged trick twice, and they share a single vote. Polishing those copies to an onyx shine adds no weight; a duplicated answer slashes every linked bond.
